verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents creating event types (cal-com-docs-34) and configuring them per type: selectable durations (cal-com-docs-4), custom booking-form questions via `bookingFields` (cal-com-docs-40, cal-com-docs-59), and a location per booking defaulting to Cal Video or Zoom/Teams/Meet on the event type's owner (cal-com-docs-73). Confirmation rules are only implied by reschedulable 'pending' bookings 'awaiting host confirmation' (cal-com-docs-39), and one community report says the free tier dropped to 1 active event type after a trial (cal-com-comm-4-refresh-07faf367462d589e), which limits 'multiple' on that plan. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs for a per-event-type requires-confirmation setting, clarity on how many event types each plan allows, and independent hands-on corroboration of per-type locations and questions.
